purpose: Five alternative opening-slide image concepts, not a five-slide sequence. Template was not attached in the current message, so these are standalone previews.

concepts.name: The customer prompt
concepts.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: one complete opening-slide image concept for a university AI fashion-assistant presentation, landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: Create a refined, clear presentation slide showing the customer prompt as the starting point of an AI recommendation. This is one single slide, not a collage of alternatives.
Style: elegant contemporary fashion editorial combined with restrained presentation typography. White background, charcoal text, blue accents derived from the blue dress. Generous whitespace and strong legibility from the back of a room.
Composition: large plain title in the upper left. Below it, a large customer quote takes the left half, with the key words blue, dress, beach wedding and under $150 subtly highlighted in blue. The right half shows a beautifully photographed fictional blue summer wedding guest dress, isolated on a hanger, with a small tasteful photographic glimpse of sand and sea behind it. The clothing is conceptual imagery, not a real catalogue listing. Keep the scene and typography composed as a flat slide, no app interface or dashboard cards.
Text, verbatim, and only this text:
"AI Recommendation System"
"I'm looking for a blue dress for a beach wedding, under $150."
"Customer prompt"
"Shopping preferences"
The last two labels can sit discreetly beneath the respective left and right halves. No additional claims or explanatory paragraphs.
Constraints: minimal opening slide, exact spelling, readable text, no page number, no watermark, no logos, no robots, no brain icon, no code screenshot, no excessive glow, no invented product price or catalogue name. This should introduce the topic and leave its detailed decision process to the next slide.

concepts.name: Four needs in one sentence
concepts.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: one complete opening-slide image concept for a university AI fashion-assistant presentation, landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: Design a typography-led slide that makes a nontechnical audience see four distinct shopping needs inside one natural sentence.
Style: clean, flat, modern presentation design with premium editorial typography. White or very pale neutral background, charcoal and blue only. This must feel clearly different from a photo-led title slide.
Composition: title at the top left. A very large, beautifully typeset quote occupies the centre in two or three lines. Subtly underline the exact phrase "blue dress", "beach wedding" and "under $150" in blue. Along the bottom, four generously spaced, flat text columns extract the four meanings. No surrounding boxes, panels, pills, rounded cards or app UI. A small unobtrusive folded blue fabric photographic detail can sit at the lower right, well away from text. The quote is the hero.
Text, verbatim, and only this text:
"Understanding the Customer"
"I'm looking for a blue dress for a beach wedding, under $150."
"Product"
"Dress"
"Colour"
"Blue"
"Occasion"
"Beach wedding"
"Budget"
"Under $150"
Constraints: readable exact text, strong hierarchy, ample whitespace, one slide only, no footer or page number, no watermark, no logo, no arrows, no technical terminology beyond the labels. Do not add a flowchart. This opening slide accompanies the first part of the speaker's script, while a second slide will explain filtering and responses.

concepts.name: The fashion editorial
concepts.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: one complete opening-slide image concept for a university AI fashion-assistant presentation, landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: Create an atmospheric fashion editorial opening slide for an AI shopping stylist, with one striking fictional blue dress as the subject and minimal type.
Composition: cinematic coastal scene at a beach wedding in soft daylight. On the right half, an elegant blue wedding guest dress is displayed on a simple clothing stand, its fabric moving slightly in the sea breeze. No person needed. Sand, water and a very subtle out-of-focus wedding setting provide context, without clutter or a bridal white dress. On the left, generous pale negative space for very large charcoal text, all perfectly readable. The photographic scene can bleed gently into that pale space. Editorial restraint, realistic fabric texture and natural light.
Text, verbatim, and only this text:
"AI Stylist"
"Shopping recommendations through conversation"
Constraints: one landscape slide, professional university project tone, conceptual photography rather than an actual product screenshot. No extra body copy, no catalogue counts or check counts on this variation, no logos, no watermark, no robot imagery, no bright neon, no dashboards or UI panels. This is a visual introduction, not the technical explanation.

concepts.name: The system behind the conversation
concepts.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: one complete opening-slide image concept for a university AI fashion-assistant presentation, landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: Create a visually memorable opening slide about the extensive code supporting a simple AI shopping conversation. Use an iceberg metaphor, carefully labelled as code in the system rather than decisions per message.
Composition: white and pale blue editorial scientific illustration. At the left, a very large clear title at the top with a single small customer quotation below. At the right, an elegant translucent iceberg rises from a perfectly calm ocean line. Its small visible tip suggests the simple chat a customer sees; its large submerged portion contains subtle blue textile-like threads and fine interconnected points, suggesting supporting system logic. This is a single composed illustration, not a flowchart or UI dashboard. Along the lower left, one huge number and its exact two-line descriptor form the main evidence. Keep all type clear and away from illustration.
Text, verbatim, and only this text:
"Behind a Simple Conversation"
"Something cheaper, please."
"250+"
"conditional checks in our code"
Constraints: label the count as static checks in our code, never as checks run for every message, independent AI decisions, accuracy or model reasoning. Do not add another number or make performance claims. Conceptual metaphor only. Minimal slide, no paragraph, no watermark, no logos, no robot, no brain icon, no giant circuit-board background, no em dash.

concepts.name: A conversation that adapts
concepts.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: one complete opening-slide image concept for a university AI fashion-assistant presentation, landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: Create a minimal narrative opening slide that shows how an AI stylist remembers the customer's preferences when they ask for a cheaper option.
Style: restrained fashion editorial collage on a white background, charcoal type, blue details, carefully balanced generous whitespace. Composition should be clearly different from other title-slide variations.
Composition: large title top left. Beneath it, two open typographic moments arranged across the slide with two different fictional blue dress cutout photographs. The first quote is on the left near a blue dress on a hanger. The short follow-up quote appears slightly right of centre near a second distinct blue dress on a hanger. Both dresses should suit a beach wedding. The text along the bottom ties the two moments together. Use plain quote text and subtle light rules only, no chat bubbles, cards, app chrome, arrows or fake UI controls.
Text, verbatim, and only this text:
"A Conversation That Remembers"
"A blue dress for a beach wedding, under $150."
"Something cheaper."
"Same colour and occasion. Lower-priced options."
Constraints: fictional conceptual dresses, no invented catalogue prices, no claim that the pictured dresses are actual recommendations. Legible text, one landscape slide only, no footer/page number, no watermark, no logos, no technical diagram, no em dash. Keep the opening simple so a second slide can explain the underlying process.
